description: Cryptographically verify a Ministry of Gems Digital Gemstone Passport by stone ID. Recomputes the SHA-256 digest of the signed record and checks its Ed25519 (EdDSA) signature against the house public key, then returns the attested record: species, carat, dimensions, cut, colour, clarity, origin, treatment and certificate status. Use when a buyer asks whether a stone or its passport is genuine, or before quoting any fact about a specific Ministry of Gems stone.

stone_id.description: Stone ID as printed on the passport or product page, e.g. "12322", "RUBY-B0797", "80067".

name: verify_gem_passport

active.description: False when the house has revoked or superseded this passport.

verified.description: True only when digest and signature both check out. A withdrawn passport can still be verified:true — read active/withdrawn before relying on the record.

title: Verify a Digital Gemstone Passport
